paragraphs.text: You try to commit the wording of “Command Ye Celestial Flames” to memory. The text is full of strange characters and you can only make a best guess as to their pronunciation. The full chant will take twenty seconds or so. The commentary offers some advice:
“Turn ye not yr eye from the fire, tho it dost Water from the Heat. And commit yr Heart and Mind in full to the path which ye intend to walk, lest ye falter at the Tryal.”

You have discovered a secret. If the situation seems right for it, the text may offer you the option to chant. At that point, if you want to try this ritual, add 50 to your current entry number and go to that new entry.
